name: Karneval -Umeshiro-mura Kaikitan-
source:
Umeshiro is a village that has been deserted for over 40 years.
There has been a traditional old ceremony in this village.

One day, a freelance writer traveled to Umeshiro and went missing.
Sora Tochika, another freelancer, decides to go investigate the village.

A sealed village's ceremony has opened tonight.

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE053648.html]DLsite English[/url], edited for grammar]
translation:
梅城是一个已经荒废了40多年的村庄。
这个村子里一直有一个传统的古老仪式。

有一天，一位自由作家前往梅城失踪。
另一位自由职业者Sora Tochika决定去调查这个村庄。

封村仪式今晚开幕。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE053648.html]DLsite英文[/url]，语法编辑]
